reviews.title: Two machines held to each other, within what the survey walks
reviews.relation: Directly relevant to the exact boundary of the survey: its corpus cross-check explicitly limits equality claims to places both machines ran and says deeper chains are not paired. That caveat is accurate for the cross-check; it does not establish that a PDF/A conformance predicate may treat an unvisited place as absent.
reviews.verdict: Retain the bounded cross-check scope. Do not use its partial-coverage caveat as evidence that an archive requirement was checked.

reviews.title: Overprint mode 1 is a statement under ICC marks and a press's loss under DeviceCMYK
reviews.relation: Relevant precedent in another archive consumer: it explicitly refuses a transformation when Survey::stopped_short, because a state it did not reach could change the result. This demonstrates that the codebase already treats stopped_short as a meaningful incomplete-evidence signal. It does not resolve the archive graphics predicate gap.
reviews.verdict: Keep the transform refusal. Apply the same evidence discipline to the report row that consumes the incomplete transparency set.

reviews.title: A pattern is given the nothing it was read against, an associated file is dated, and Annex Q reads the painted state
reviews.relation: Relevant to Annex Q source interpretation and current actual-state coverage. It corrected detection to mark transparency when an element is painted under the applicable state and added valid state-restoration controls. It neither claims unlimited traversal nor discusses whether a truncated walk can produce a validation Met result.
reviews.verdict: No challenge to the painted-state correction. Add an independent incomplete-input/report regression; do not characterize ADR 2820's semantic tests as covering traversal caps.

decision: The local bounds are implementation safeguards, not source-defined safe ceilings. Keep them. Correct the consumer/report path so a bound-triggered partial walk cannot yield a checked Met for a transparency requirement that depends on the missing content. An explicit unchecked/refusal outcome is a truthful option; no unlimited-support promise is implied.
remaining_scope: Only the Annex Q page-transparency archive consumer is adjudicated. Audit other Survey-backed predicates separately to determine which observations they depend on and how each handles a stopped walk.
